title: LYCEUM export manifest (lyceum-export-manifest) 1.0 — export-manifest.json
description: The last entry of an export bundle: what the zip holds, so a reader can check it without LYCEUM. Unknown keys are allowed, so a later 1.x may add one. Rules 1-5 are those of exchange/README.md. That each media path names its own sha256 and that no path appears twice are checked by tool/exchange/validate_examples.py; that the manifest describes the bundle's own lyceum.json and files is the reader's check.

media.description: The media files the zip holds, in path order.

missing_media.description: Media files a row names that the store did not have (missing) or not whole (damaged) when the export ran, in path order; recorded, never fatal. May be absent.

formatVersion.description: Rule 2: MAJOR.MINOR in plain decimal; this schema reads major 1, any minor.

schemaVersion.description: Rule 3: LyceumDatabase.currentVersion of the app that wrote the bundle.

mediaPath.description: media/<h[0:2]>/<h[2:4]>/<sha256>, the file's content-addressed store path under media/.
